name: Puca's Mischief — Permanent B is an opponent's nonland permanent with equal or lesser mana value than A
notes: "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exchange control of target nonland permanent you control and target nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value." (2026-10-18, with Spawnbroker: the same bound on mana value.) A lists your nonland permanents (Hill Giant 4, Puca's Mischief 4, not your Forest); with Hill Giant as A, B lists Grizzly Bears (2) and Llanowar Elves (1), not Craw Wurm (6) or the opponent's Island. Hill Giant and Grizzly Bears change controllers.
